mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential investment (RSAFS) indicate broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), a decline in CPIAUCSL signals excessive policy tightening, prompting rate cut expectations and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising with CPIAUCSL decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST increases month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll growth rate (PAYEMS) below 50,000 jobs signals labor market weakness, triggering risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS monthly change is below 50.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDP annualized growth > 2.0%), a quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals imminent slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0% and GDPC1 < GDPC1[-1]
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when GDP growth exceeds 2.0% annually and GDP declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in unemployment (UNRATE) and fall in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates policy response to economic distress, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE rises and FEDFUNDS falls, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
